g.text: Objective: turn each accepted analysis into its verdict, its place on the list pages and its own pages, then put the site online.

text.tspan: docs/DESIGN.md
the viewer's theme
GitHub Pages
https://<owner>.github.io/<repo>/
the company has its verdict
margin of safety (MoS) = intrinsic value ÷ price;
list row fields: ticker, name, verdict, MoS, price, intrinsic value, story type, red and yellow flags, analysis date, value line;
list rows read the verdict text the sidecar carries,
the value line and the grid cells recompute it from their own MoS
the company is on the list pages
verdict counts: all = every company, then one per verdict;
filters all, undervalued, fair, overvalued, na;
sorts ticker, mos, date;
directions asc, desc;
ties by ticker ascending, and rows without a MoS last when sorted by MoS
the company pages are written
c/TICKER.html for the newest analysis and c/TICKER/YYYY-MM-DD.html for each analysis, the list page with the detail;
f/ holds the same paths, the detail alone
the site is live
the site folder is uploaded as the Pages artifact,
then the deploy job runs after the build job
Comes out:
the live static viewer: index.html, l/, rows/, c/, f/, 404.html, robots.txt, static/
the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [margin of safety (MoS) 1.3 or more]
potentially undervalued, filter value undervalued
the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [margin of safety (MoS) from 1.0 to under 1.3]
around fair value, filter value fair
the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [margin of safety (MoS) below 1.0]
potentially overvalued, filter value overvalued
the build reads the verdict from the sidecar [no price]
n/a, filter value na

g.text: the list pages show the company
the build writes the company pages
